**Meta had the higher operating margin in fiscal 2025, by about 27.7 percentage points.**

- **Meta:** Income from operations was $83,276M on revenue of $200,966M, a margin of about 41.44%.
- **Disney:** Disney does not report an operating income line in these excerpts, so I derived it. I took total revenues of $94,425M, subtracted total costs and expenses of $80,593M, and subtracted restructuring and impairment charges of $819M. That gives about $13,013M, or a margin of about 13.78%.

The difference is 41.44% − 13.78% ≈ 27.66 percentage points. Disney's figure depends on my definition of operating income, which excludes equity in the income of investees, interest expense and other income (expense), net.
